findings.title: Comment references a migration filename that does not exist
findings.body: The comment points to '0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py' as the correct migration, but the revised migration in this PR is 0920_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_revised.py. The pointer is wrong and will mislead maintainers looking for the replacement.

findings.title: Revised migration body was stubbed out, so org saved searches are never converted
findings.body: The conversion logic was removed and replaced with a bare return, while the comment says the migration 'had an error and was never run' and points to a non-existent 0921 file. The revised migration is the one that is supposed to run in production, so existing organization saved searches will never be converted into GroupSearchViews. This is a silent data-migration loss, and the deleted test for 0917 removes the only coverage.

findings.title: Parameterizer.parametrize_w_experiments drops the regex-experiment path but ParameterizationExperiment is now only callable experiments
findings.body: The Parameterizer no longer distinguishes regex experiments; any caller that still constructs a ParameterizationRegex-based experiment (or the removed ParameterizationRegexExperiment) will fail at runtime. The removal of the public __all__ entry is an API break for anything importing it, and the removed tests were the only coverage for regex experiments.

findings.title: Removes registered option grouping.experiments.parameterization.traceparent
findings.body: The option is deleted while the 'traceparent' regex is still in DEFAULT_PARAMETERIZATION_REGEXES and tests still expect traceparent parameterization. Any deployment that has this option set in configuration or code that reads it will now hit an unregistered-option error.

findings.title: Logging extra now uses workflow_event_data but the surrounding code logs per-workflow data
findings.body: Changing 'event_data' to 'workflow_event_data' in the log extra alters the logged payload semantics; the field name is unchanged so downstream log queries keyed on event_data may now see per-environment data for the same key. Minor, but worth confirming intent.

findings.title: Null max_segment_id skip hides rows from the deletion job without marking them
findings.body: When max_segment_id is None, _make_recording_filenames returns no files, but delete_replays still archives the replay. Replays with no ingested segments are archived without verifying there are no leftover blobs; the comment says segments may be missing but the behavior silently skips any stored video/recording blobs for those replays.

findings.title: Snuba query result indexed without checking shape
findings.body: response[0].get('error_ids') assumes process_raw_response returns a non-empty list of dicts; if query_replay_instance returns no rows the code falls back to [], but for a missing error_ids key the default is fine only if the first row is a dict. Also query_replay_instance is now called on every request before pagination, adding an extra Snuba round trip to the summarize path with no caching.

findings.title: Error events merged in by timestamp assumes breadcrumb timestamps are seconds, with the error sort mutating shared input
findings.body: get_request_data sorts error_events in place via list.sort, mutating the caller's list. Combined with functools.partial reuse across pagination pages, error_events is re-sorted on each page. The per-page merge also re-emits every error before each segment's events that follows it, so the same error can appear in multiple pages or be dropped from later pages because the error_idx state is recomputed per page.

findings.title: Strict validation now returns 422 for whole batch on a single malformed report
findings.body: Previously invalid reports did not reject the request; now one invalid report in the array causes the entire batch to return 422 and the valid reports are not recorded. Browsers sending batched reports will lose all data for an invalid entry, and the new validation also rejects fields like age vs timestamp that the spec permits, changing behavior for existing clients.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template is a staticmethod that calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, but it is defined on CommitContextIntegration
findings.body: The helper references PRCommentWorkflow, which is not defined in this module scope at that point, so the call to _truncate_title will raise NameError at runtime when comments are generated. The base class method should use self or the class directly.

findings.title: get_environment_info logs the exception object as a field and swallows all errors
findings.body: A broad except Exception logs at info level with the raw exception object in extra, which is not serializable into structured logs and hides real failures (e.g. DB errors) behind a silent empty environment string.

findings.title: Owner update applies even when not provided by user and clears owner on partial update
findings.body: In update(), 'owner' in validated_data is checked, but ActorField is not required; when the owner is None-valued and a client sends a partial update that omits owner, the branch is skipped correctly. However when owner is explicitly passed as None it clears both fields, and the create path does not validate that the owner belongs to the organization, letting cross-organization actors be assigned as owners.

findings.title: Module logger switched to log_context logger without a corresponding behavior test
findings.body: logger is replaced with log_context.get_logger which may not support the standard logging keyword arguments used throughout this module (extra=...). Calls such as logger.info(..., extra=...) rely on the stdlib signature, and the change has no test coverage.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before the feature-flag check, and it uses the wrong event name
findings.body: analytics.record is called before features.has, so requests for orgs without the feature still emit 'preprod_artifact.api.assemble' events. The event is also registered as PreprodArtifactApiAssembleEvent but recorded by string without the registered class being imported by the endpoint, so analytics metadata is inconsistent with the other preprod events.

findings.title: processing_deadline_duration=60 may be shorter than check_single_auth_identity work for chunk_size=100
findings.body: The task now has a 60-second deadline but processes up to chunk_size identities sequentially with external provider refresh calls; a full chunk can exceed the deadline, causing retries and duplicated work.

findings.title: LoadingPlaceholder passes an empty columnOrder and sets no tableData; placeholder rendering is untested
findings.body: The LoadingPlaceholder renders GridEditable with no columns and no data; this is only exercised in stories and has no spec. Minor, but it is public API used by chart.tsx indirectly.

findings.title: TabularColumn type duplicated in a fixture file
findings.body: TabularColumn is newly exported here while tests/js/fixtures/tabularColumn.ts duplicates the shape; fixture types drift when the canonical type changes.

findings.title: Table widget renders a hard-coded empty table behind a feature flag
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is on, TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty tableData, discarding result.data, fields, and meta entirely. Any org with the flag enabled sees empty tables for all table widgets.

findings.title: Hook doc comment and removed enabled option leave callers without an enabled guard
findings.body: The previously supported enabled and search options were removed from the hook, but the hook still performs an API request on every call with no cancellation or dedupe, which can cause duplicate fetches on each keystroke in transactionNameSearchBar.

findings.title: Attribute keys query now runs through useQuery with a key that does not include the query function's inputs
findings.body: The query key is built from makeTraceItemAttributeKeysQueryOptions, which omits environment, while the queryFn captures projectIds from the closure; key and fn can diverge so cached results can be served for different project sets.

findings.title: Variant type rows removed from grouping info panel
findings.body: The 'Type' row with its explanatory tooltip is deleted from every variant case, so users lose the only description of what each grouping variant type means, and the COMPONENT case now has an empty statement block.

findings.title: Visualize model changed from multi-yAxis to single yAxis, breaking persisted and URL-encoded visualizes
findings.body: Visualize now holds a single yAxis, but parseBaseVisualize and saved queries still encode yAxes arrays; multi-yAxis queries from existing URLs and saved explore queries are silently truncated or split, changing chart definitions for existing users.

findings.title: Writable field refs filter now uses isBaseVisualize but reads a yAxes array that the old code did not guarantee
findings.body: findAllFieldRefs changed the filter to BaseVisualize but still flatMaps visualize.yAxes; combined with the Visualize API change this is inconsistent with the rest of the file which now uses yAxis.

findings.title: Top-events suppression for multi-yAxis charts removed while chart still supports multiple visualize entries
findings.body: The check that disabled topEvents when any visualize had multiple yAxes was deleted, so grouped top-N queries can now be issued for charts that the chart renderer cannot represent correctly.

findings.title: Feature gate checked only in the component, but the hook still fires the summary request
findings.body: useFeedbackSummary enables the query based on the feature flag but FeedbackSummary still calls it unconditionally, so non-entitled orgs issue summary requests that always fail, and the retry: 1 doubles the cost.

findings.title: Analytics event renamed from replay.view_html to replay.view-html without updating the event map entry
findings.body: The emitted event name changed to 'replay.view-html' while replayAnalyticsEvents.tsx still defines 'replay.view-html' as the key; the rename breaks existing dashboards and alerts that filter on replay.view_html.

findings.title: Transparent mask gradient now uses theme background, changing visual output for transparentMask carousels
findings.body: The transparent variant changed from rgba(255,255,255) white to the theme background, altering appearance in dark mode and not covered by any test.

findings.title: minmax arguments are reversed for grid column
findings.body: grid-template-columns: minmax(195px, 1fr) 1.5fr is correct now, but the removed rule minmax(1fr, 195px) was invalid; the change is fine but the list grid now also wraps FeedbackList in a new column container that is not covered by layout tests.

findings.title: Changing the owner feature on create without validating org membership in the serializer
findings.body: owner is accepted via ActorField without checking membership in the organization; test_owner_not_in_organization expects a 400 but the validator does not enforce it, so that test will fail or the behavior is untested.
